training: Class-conditional uncentered means of bundled phase features; no gradient optimization. Exact symbolic comparator evaluates the matching explicit one-hot term kernel. Frequencies retained; class sizes normalized, not learned priors.
selection: Same representation-specific train/selection losses for both backends, then tied best validation loss, then fewest fields, at most four. Overflow/unsupported veto. Off uses all six fields, not a hidden hand-selected mask.
supervision: Standard 24 train + 16 selection + 8 clean calibration + 16 test full contexts. Off does not use selection labels to select or weight but reports validation diagnostics. Small-train tasks use 8 train. Ambiguity 8+4+4+8, plus 8 separate added train examples after refit. Oracle completion table is evaluator-only, never passed to fit or runtime.
scope: Seven bounded families (five dependencies, structured role inversion, structured polarity/modality), five small-train conditions, two correlated ambiguity tasks before/after. Not a new Japanese reader or generator; v0.10 preserved separately.
missing_semantics: Remove each individual field, deduplicate partial contexts, plus fully missing. Gold is all compatible completions of evaluator-only truth table. Any confirmed label with more than one possible label is an unsafe confirmation even if compatible with hidden original.
numeric_observation: SS only: encode a complete context then erase a shared random coordinate mask. Explicit observed mask is side information; normalize correlation by observed count; all-erased must abstain. Fixed calibration from complete clean inputs, no retuning for corruption. This is a P1-oriented probe, not integration with existing P1/S1.
budget: Main SS modes have D complex coefficients per class per candidate. Ambiguity/validation additionally uses fixed-total D per class split in 128-coefficient units among candidates. Exact comparator reports its own count-table and metadata costs; it has no matching numeric-erasure experiment. Equal D is not equal RAM.
acceptance: No new method must win. Freeze data/source/settings before final evaluation, repeat numerics, report all errors/abstentions, validate packets/splits/metric accounting, isolated refit and numeric-only CLI, preserve v0.10 hashes. Controls: exact additive XOR cannot fully recover, product/hybrid can; zero learned weights cannot confirm; complete erasure cannot confirm.
decision: Do not automatically replace the language core. Any advantage must be described with coverage, errors, supervision and actual storage/time costs. No statistical safety guarantee.
